description: Sudan Main Roads is a data set listed in ICPAC Geoportal (IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Centre), a regional geoportal (GeoNode), published or maintained by ICPAC. Sudan Main Roads provided by the government of Sudan through Humanitarian Aid Commission (HAC). Coverage: Sudan. The portal files it under the publisher ICPAC. The portal shows 2014-04-21 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (data set page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support road network, traffic and accessibility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-icpac-portal.
